$Comment: One full swing of a great pendulum's hits (8 s, out and back), matching the PendulumSwing clip the role loops on the Status slot: a radius 1.5 sphere at the blade every 0.125 s (tightened from 1.7 every 0.25 s, which hit beside the blade), the tick at each end, the whoosh as it passes the bottom. No hit while the bob's lowest point is above head height (21 - 20.5 cos angle > 1.6, near the ends of the swing), so it cannot hit a player it visibly passes over.
